title: Dependency Hygiene
objective: Check each dependency's license against the team's allow list before it is added, give a reason for each dependency that needs review, and recognize why a generated suggestion is not an approval.
expected:
dependency highlight.js (BSD-3-Clause): allowed
dependency markdown-it (MIT): allowed
dependency logging-kit (Apache-2.0): allowed
dependency some-parser (GPL-3.0): needs review, not on the allow list
dependency mystery-lib (no license found): needs review, no license found
